definitions.explanation: A small cell fragment in the blood that plays a key role in clotting and wound healing.

examples.english: Platelets play the role of stopping bleeding.

examples.english: The blood test results showed the platelet value was below the normal range, so a retest was scheduled.

notes:
A medical term composed of {血|けつ} (blood), {小|しょう} (small), and {板|ばん} (plate). Platelets are one of three main components of blood along with ⟦{赤血球|せっけっきゅう}→赤血球：20823_sekkekkyuu⟧ (red blood cells) and ⟦{白血球|はっけっきゅう}→白血球：23120_hakkekkyuu⟧ (white blood cells). Learners may encounter this word at doctor's visits or when reading blood test results in Japan.
